title: 4th Science Pacing Support
scope: Excerpts only: lesson-content lines ClassThread items cite. No names, rosters, small-group links or student information.
content:
[Jan 4–8 weekly block, Unit 4: Role of Organisms and Flow of Energy (I Can)] I can create food chains, identify producers, consumers, and decomposers, and explain how changes in an ecosystem affect the energy available to living things.
[Jan 4–8 weekly block, day grid, Tuesday 5] Begin Unit 4: Role of Organisms and Flow of Energy
[UbD planning document, Unit 4: Role of Organisms and Flow of Energy, Established Goals] S4L1. Obtain, evaluate, and communicate information about the roles of organisms and the flow of energy within an ecosystem.
[UbD planning document, Unit 4, Vocabulary] Vocabulary: producer, consumer, decomposer, food chain, food web, ecosystem, energy flow, community
[UbD planning document, Unit 4, Understanding] Energy flows from the sun through producers to consumers and decomposers in a food chain or web.
[UbD planning document, Unit 4, Understanding] All organisms in an ecosystem play a role — producer, consumer, or decomposer — in the flow of energy.
[UbD planning document, Unit 4, Understanding] Changes in an ecosystem affect the organisms living within it.
[UbD planning document, Unit 4, Stage 2 Learning Target (S4L1.b)] I can: create food chains and food webs to model energy flow.
[UbD planning document, Unit 4, Stage 2 Learning Target (S4L1.a)] I can: identify producers, consumers, and decomposers in an ecosystem.
